# Benz World (M) Sdn Bhd
> Car workshop in Permas Jaya, Masai, Johor Bahru, Malaysia, for Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche and other makes. Website: https://benzworld.my/

- Address: No. 66, Jalan Permas 9/13, Bandar Baru Permas Jaya, 81750 Masai, Johor, Malaysia
- Hours: Mon to Sat 9:00am to 7:00pm; Sunday Closed
- WhatsApp: +60 12-716 2860 (mobile)
- Phone: +60 7-388 2660 (workshop line), +60 12-716 2860 (Google listing)
- Company no.: 202001016511 (1372831-U)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BenzWorldMSdnBhd/
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Benz+World+(M)+Sdn+Bhd/@1.4960935,103.822687,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x31da6b607c3cadb1:0xdca83755bfe342a6!8m2!3d1.4960935!4d103.822687!16s%2Fg%2F1tffg91p

## Services
- Car computer diagnostics
- Standard routine servicing
- Engine overhaul
- Gearbox overhaul
- Air conditioning services
- Brakes repair
- Suspension repair and parts
- Wheel, tyres and rims services
- Wheel alignment and balancing
- Vehicle pick-up and delivery
- Battery services
- Electrical part repair
- Wiring repair
- Mechanical part repair
- Engine tuning and conversion
- Performance parts and upgrades
- Car wash and polish
- Accessories retail
